full_prompt_en: The image is a square black-and-white street photograph of a lone man in a dark coat standing beside his reflection on a rainy waterfront. He stands slightly right of center in profile, facing left with his head bowed beneath a dark brimmed hat. The long coat falls straight toward his knees, making him a solid black vertical shape against the pale mist. Directly below his feet, a large puddle mirrors his hat and coat as a darker, wavering silhouette reaching almost to the bottom edge. The wet pavement in the foreground is smooth and reflective, interrupted by a diagonal seam where it meets rough cobblestones in the middle distance. At the far left, a small dark car blurs as it passes across the open square. A thin three-lamp post stands farther back near the left third. Beyond a low stone wall, a tall distant tower and lower buildings fade into the white-gray haze, their outlines barely visible. A building edge closes the right side of the frame, but most of the space remains open and empty. The camera is level and slightly distant, letting the man occupy a modest part of the square while his reflection doubles his vertical presence. Overcast light is flat and silvery, with dark coat, car, and lamp post providing the strongest values. Mist erases far detail and softens the skyline; wet cobbles retain small texture, while the foreground puddle becomes a broad dark-gray plane. The composition is quiet and solitary, organized by the standing figure, its downward echo, and the long horizontal wall behind them.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一张方形黑白街头摄影：一位穿深外套的男子站在雨中滨水地面倒影旁。他站在中央略右，以侧身朝左，头在深色有檐帽下低着。长外套笔直落到膝部，使他在浅雾前成为一块结实的黑色竖形。他脚下正前方，一大滩水把帽子和大衣映成更暗而摇晃的剪影，几乎垂到下画边。前景湿铺地平顺而反光，被一条与中景粗石路面相接的斜缝打断。最左侧，一辆小暗车模糊地驶过开阔广场。较远处靠左三分之一的位置立一根三头细路灯。低石墙外，一座高远塔和更低的建筑淡入白灰雾里，轮廓几乎不可辨。建筑边缘封住右画边，但多数空间仍开放而空。相机平视且略远，让男子只占方形的一小部分，倒影却把他的竖向存在翻倍。阴天天光平而银亮，深外套、车和路灯给出最强明度。雾抹去远处细节并柔化天际线；湿石路仍带细小纹理，前景水洼则化成宽暗灰平面。构图安静而孤独，由站立人形、向下的回声及其后的长横墙组织。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white documentary photography uses open negative space, a modest dark vertical accent, and a long soft reflection below it. Rain-dark pavement alternates between smooth mirrored areas and finely textured stone, divided by a clean diagonal edge. Flat overcast light keeps most tones in pale and middle gray, while a few near-black forms remain strong. Mist reduces the distant background to faint layered silhouettes behind a long low horizontal boundary. Slight motion blur softens one small lateral accent; the primary vertical stays still and sharply readable. The frame feels quiet and observational, with depth coming from atmosphere, tonal reduction, and the reflective foreground.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白纪实摄影采用开放留白、一处不大的暗竖形与其下长长的柔和倒影。雨湿铺面在平顺镜像区和细纹石质区之间交替，被一道清楚斜边分开。平而多云的光让多数调子处于浅灰与中灰，少数近黑形体仍有力度。雾把远方背景压成低矮长横界线后的淡淡层叠剪影。一处小横向点缀因轻微运动模糊变柔，主要竖形保持静止且清晰可读。画幅安静而像现场观察，纵深来自空气、调子压缩与前景反射。
theme_en: A lone man in a dark coat standing beside his reflection on a rainy waterfront
theme_zh: 一位穿深外套的男子站在雨中滨水地面的倒影旁
